# Startquestion

> > Online survey platform offering templates, tools, and best practices for customer feedback, HR research, and market analysis with NPS, CSAT, and CES metrics.

Startquestion provides survey creation tools and ready-to-use templates for businesses, HR professionals, and researchers. The platform supports multilingual surveys (English, Spanish, French, Italian) with integrations like Zapier and compliance with GDPR standards.

## Key Topics

- Net Promoter Score (NPS)
- Customer Satisfaction (CSAT)
- Customer Effort Score (CES)
- Survey templates
- Customer feedback
- Market research
- HR feedback and recruitment
- Candidate experience
- GDPR compliance
- Churn analytics
- Brand awareness
- Online survey best practices
- SWOT Analysis
- Zapier integration
- Employee feedback

## Survey Best Practices & Guides

- [Online Surveys: How to Avoid the Top 10 Common Mistakes?](https://www.startquestion.com/blog/10-most-common-mistakes-in-online-surveys): Survey design best practices guide covering GDPR and common methodology errors
- [15 Top Product Survey Questions](https://www.startquestion.com/blog/15-top-product-survey-questions): Product survey questions guide for market fit and customer feedback research
- [Churn Analytics: Why You Should Track User Churn Rate?](https://www.startquestion.com/blog/churn-analytics-track-user-churn-rate): CustomerHero guide on tracking churn rate and improving customer retention

## Customer Feedback & Satisfaction Templates

- [Encuesta de satisfacción del cliente](https://www.startquestion.com/es/ejemplos-de-encuestas/encuesta-de-satisfaccion-del-cliente): Spanish customer satisfaction survey template with CSAT, NPS, and CES metrics
- [Encuesta sobre la calidad del servicio](https://www.startquestion.com/es/ejemplos-de-encuestas/encuesta-sobre-la-calidad-del-servicio): Spanish service quality survey template with NPS customer feedback metrics
- [Competitive Analysis Survey](https://www.startquestion.com/survey-template/competitor-survey): Competitor analysis template with NPS, SWOT, and SEMrush market research tools
- [Brand Awareness Survey](https://www.startquestion.com/fr/exemple-de-questionnaire/brand-awareness-survey-2): French brand awareness and recognition marketing survey template

## HR & Recruitment Survey Templates

- [Candidate Experience Survey: The Best Questions and Template](https://www.startquestion.com/blog/candidate-experience-survey-free-template): HR recruitment survey guide with Talent Board insights and free template
- [Remote work generates conflicts! Prevent them with online surveys for HR](https://www.startquestion.com/blog/remote-work-surveys-for-hr): HR guide on using surveys to prevent remote work conflicts post-COVID-19
- [Supervisor Feedback Survey](https://www.startquestion.com/survey-template/cooperation-with-the-supervisor-survey): HR template for manager evaluation and leadership assessment feedback
- [Cuestionario de satisfacción de un curso](https://www.startquestion.com/es/ejemplos-de-encuestas/encuesta-de-satisfaccion-de-un-curso): Spanish training course satisfaction template for HR employee development

## Event & Education Survey Templates

- [Post-Webinar Feedback](https://www.startquestion.com/fr/exemple-de-questionnaire/post-webinar-feedback): French webinar feedback template for event optimization and attendee surveys
- [Sondaggio tra gli studenti per la tesi](https://www.startquestion.com/it/modelli-di-sondaggi/sondaggio-tra-gli-studenti-per-la-tesi): Italian student thesis research survey template for academic questionnaires
